principles: Validate the nested parallelGate object field-by-field with a dedicated helper; never reuse the flat scalar path
Fail SOFT: any malformed sub-field warns once and falls back; a config error never crashes or DoSes resolution
Use the gate value set VALID_PARALLEL_MODES, not the AuditMode set; an invalid mode degrades to advise (the safe non-blocking mode)
Single source: import the value set and types from parallel-decomposition.ts; reuse the existing positive-integer guard
drivers: parallelGate is a nested object; the flat per-scalar override path does not recurse into it
mode advise|block|off is disjoint from AuditMode, so VALID_MODES cannot validate it
The strict profile must default broadGlobBlocks=true (hard-block broad globs); light and balanced default false

options.name: dedicated-two-param-helper
pros: Pure and decoupled (raw + explicit profileDefault), independently testable
Validates EVERY nested sub-field with its own guard and fallback
Reuses the existing positive-integer guard and warn-fallback discipline
cons: Minor deviation from the spec one-param illustration (documented)

options.name: spec-one-param-internal-lookup
cons: Couples the helper to the profile-default table and WorkflowProfile, less pure, harder to unit-test in isolation

options.name: inline-nested-validation
cons: Bloats resolveAuditConfig and is harder to test; risks mirroring the flat-pattern anti-pattern the spec warns against

rationale: A pure two-param helper validates the nested object completely and is independently testable; the spec one-param illustration is non-normative and would couple the helper to the profile-default table. It reuses the project positive-integer guard and warn-fallback discipline.

preMortem.trigger: parallelGate is a non-object (string/array/number) and the helper indexes into it
preMortem.mitigation: resolveParallelGate guards !raw || typeof raw not object || Array.isArray(raw) and returns a copy of profileDefault; the smoke asserts a non-object parallelGate yields all profile defaults

preMortem.trigger: an unknown mode string slips through and is later treated as block
preMortem.consequence: a typo in config wrongly hard-blocks PLAN to DEV
preMortem.mitigation: mode is validated against VALID_PARALLEL_MODES; invalid warns and falls back to advise (the safe non-blocking value), never block; the smoke asserts invalid mode -> advise

preMortem.trigger: copying the flat scalar pattern which does not recurse into parallelGate
preMortem.consequence: a bad maxConcurrentReview or broadGlobBlocks reaches the gate unvalidated
preMortem.mitigation: the dedicated helper validates EACH sub-field with its own guard; the smoke asserts a non-integer max and a non-boolean broadGlobBlocks each fall back

preMortem.scenario: The no-user-config path returns parallelGate undefined
preMortem.trigger: adding parallelGate only in the merged branch, not in profileDefaults (the early-return object)
preMortem.consequence: with no user config parallelGate is undefined and the gate gets no config (Story 5 would fail open)
preMortem.mitigation: parallelGate is added to profileDefaults AND the merged object; the smoke asserts each profile default resolves even with no user config

preMortem.scenario: Wrong value set used for validation
preMortem.consequence: advise and block are rejected as invalid
preMortem.mitigation: validate against VALID_PARALLEL_MODES imported from parallel-decomposition.ts; the smoke asserts advise, block and off are all accepted
